<script setup lang="ts">
import HeroSection from './components/HeroSection.vue'
import FeaturesSection from './components/FeaturesSection.vue'
import UserCounter from './components/UserCounter.vue'

function scrollToFeatures() {
  const target = document.getElementById('features')
  if (!target) return
  const reduceMotion = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches
  target.scrollIntoView({ behavior: reduceMotion ? 'auto' : 'smooth', block: 'start' })
}
</script>

<template>
  <main class="min-h-screen bg-slate-950 text-slate-100 antialiased">
    <HeroSection @start="scrollToFeatures" />
    <FeaturesSection id="features" />
    <UserCounter :target="12000" />
    <footer class="py-10 text-center text-sm text-slate-500">
      © {{ new Date().getFullYear() }} Nimbus
    </footer>
  </main>
</template>
